title: Usual handoff to support
transcript:
[00:00] Greta: Bulk edit for invoices ships Thursday. Last thing before then is support.
[00:06] Omar: Do the usual handoff to support, then. They hate surprises.
[00:11] Lucia: I'll do the usual handoff tomorrow.
[00:15] Greta: Thanks. Any known issues they should hear about?
[00:19] Omar: One. Bulk edit skips invoices that are locked for payment, and it doesn't say why.
[00:26] Lucia: I'll put that in the known issues section.
[00:30] Greta: And let's fix the message in the next sprint.
[00:34] Omar: I'll file the ticket.
[00:38] Greta: Good. Thanks.
